thread:
Maria G: T-minus 45 for runtime v3.7 prod deploy. Owners: Alex + Chris. Quick pre-deploy signoff checklist below — reply ACK/GO/HOLD and note if you'll be on-call.
Maria G: Checklist:
- [ ] Canary metrics green
- [ ] Smoke tests run on staging-preview
- [ ] Rollback command verified
- [ ] No blocking DB migrations or feature flags
- [ ] On-call coverage for first 30m
Alex T: ACK. Canary metrics green (p95 ~120ms). Load tests looked fine. I ran the hotpath perf check.
Chris L: ACK. Rollback command verified locally and in staging: 
```
# rollback to previous runtime image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference runtime=runtime:v3.6 --record
# or toggle route to dedicated pool: /api/admin/route?set=stable-v3.6
```
Sam P: I'll be on-call for 30-90m after cutover, monitoring errors and logs. Ping me if error rate > 2%.
Elaine R: Tracing hooks are enabled for this rollout. Quick smoke on staging-preview passed for prompt/response sanity. No regressions on structured output tests.
deploy-bot: preflight checks started: infra health ok, disk <70%, GPU temps normal, queue depth within baseline. No blocking alerts found.
Maria G: Nice. Final gating rule: if any owner posts HOLD before I click deploy, we stop. Otherwise I'll proceed at T-minus 5. Reply GO to proceed.
Alex T: GO :thumbsup:
Chris L: GO
Sam P: GO
Elaine R: GO
Maria G: T-minus 5 — starting orchestration in 2m. If anyone sees anything odd, type HOLD now.
Alex T: HOLD — spotted a missing feature-flag fallback for an edge route, pushing a small patch to staging now. Will confirm in 10m.
Maria G: Thanks Alex — holding. Rescheduling +20. I'll update the deploy calendar and ping infra.
Maria G: Post-update: Alex merged patch, canary replayed, metrics back to green. Re-open when ready and I will re-run deploy flow.
Alex T: Re-opened, metrics stable. Re-ACK.
Maria G: Final GO received from all owners. Preparing to initiate deploy at +2.
